tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.title: Get my KiDi+ profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in KiDi+ user's profile: handle, display name, country, currency, seller and verification status.

tools.name: list_my_lives
tools.title: List my live shows
tools.description: List the signed-in seller's KiDi+ live shows (scheduled, live or ended), newest first.

status.description: Filter by live status. Omit to include every status.

limit.description: Maximum number of lives to return.

tools.name: list_my_orders
tools.title: List my orders
tools.description: List KiDi+ orders for the signed-in user, either as seller (sales) or as buyer (purchases), newest first.

role.description: Whether to list sales (seller) or purchases (buyer).

fulfillment_status.description: Optional fulfillment status filter, e.g. pending, shipped, delivered.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return.

tools.name: list_my_products
tools.title: List my shop products
tools.description: List the signed-in seller's KiDi+ shop products with price, currency and stock.

active_only.description: Only return products currently visible in the shop.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

tools.name: get_my_balances
tools.title: Get my wallet and earnings balances
tools.description: Return the signed-in user's KiDi+ wallet balance (buying power) and, for sellers, the earnings balance (available and pending).

tools.name: list_my_earnings
tools.title: List my earnings entries
tools.description: List the signed-in seller's recent KiDi+ earnings entries (sales, gifts, adjustments), newest first.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return.
